notes: Hoarded 12-22 credits clicking for money for many turns while installing almost nothing, re-ran a known unbreakable Vampyronassa, and ended turn 12 with an empty grip against Personal Evolution, which made the flatline trivial.
Left R&D completely unprotected for 12 turns against constant R&D runs and lost Project Beale and False Lead behind a single Ping, though tag-and-damage follow-up eventually won the game.

Sat at 0 credits for the whole game, re-running R&D four times a turn to see the same top card and piling up tags, could not afford to steal Bellona several times, and won only because the Corp decked.
Clean Weyland plan: Trojan Horse on Echelon and three Send a Messages scored behind rezzed ice; leaving R&D open until turn 9 was a gamble, and Clearinghouse did nothing.
Efficient win through HQ pressure, giving up breakers to steal two Degree Mills; some passive click-for-credit turns and expensive tag clearing.
From turn 4 on, spent every turn at 0-1 credits paying to trash a runner resource and clicking for credits, never installing or advancing anything while the Runner walked into R&D unopposed.
Solid multi-access pressure with Audrey on HQ and repeated Anemone runs that won; some Archives runs with nothing new and net damage tanked for value.
Kept going into a double R&D access with one card in grip against Personal Evolution after one Fujii was already seen, so any agenda steal was lethal, and it was.
Never iced R&D, never installed or scored an agenda, and burned whole turns and all its credits repeatedly trashing the same runner resources while the Runner took 8 points from R&D.
Very slow: hoarded 35-50 credits, repeatedly playing Government Subsidy and advancing ice, before scoring three Send a Messages from turn 19; got away with it against a passive runner.
Scored two Fujiis and a False Lead quickly from a single-ice remote against a runner with no breakers; economy ran thin but the plan was coherent.
Good use of Trick Shot and Gauss on R&D and a timely remote dive; spent a lot of credits on tag removal against NBN but still got End-of-the-Lined, then closed the game with an aggressive final run.
Installed agendas three turns in a row behind a Mestnichestvo the Runner had already broken and lost all three, then clicked for credits for turns while the Runner sat on many tags unpunished.
Zero-credit R&D spam all game with dozens of repeat accesses and ignored tags; could not pay for Bellona or Degree Mill several times, ran Tsarevna down to one card, and won only by Corp decking.

Good early R&D pressure, but it gave up Aumakua to steal and was then locked off R&D by Tree Line for about ten turns, made many empty Archives/HQ runs, and lost Cezve and WAKE facechecking a three-ice remote.
Picked two Stoke the Embers to trash to an open Archives under Chastushka sabotage, giving away 4 points, then recovered by scoring four agendas behind Ping; never punished a heavily tagged runner.
Built a sensible Aumakua/Twinning/Hermes rig and won through HQ; the turn-1 WAKE install that discarded Inside Job and some idle credit clicks were minor.
Clicked for credits turn after turn at 13-21 credits with a full hand, discarding each turn, and kept agendas in HQ behind one Anansi until Ika broke it and the Runner took three agendas.
Left Phoneutria on R&D unrezzed on turn 1 with enough credits and then spent its money elsewhere, giving up 5 points, before winning via Phoneutria and Bladderwort net damage.
After early lucky R&D steals, never installed a single card and clicked for credits from 15 to 34 credits while the Corp scored four agendas almost uncontested.
